title: PROC MEANS : ORDER=FREQ (effectifs décroissants), FREQ (pondération de N et STD), ID copiée, OUTPUT / AUTONAME, MAXDEC=

provenance.source: https://documentation.sas.com/doc/en/pgmsascdc/9.4_3.5/proc/n1qnc9bddfvhzqn105kqitnf29cp.htm — Base SAS 9.4 Procedures Guide, Seventh Edition, MEANS Procedure, PROC MEANS Statement (ORDER=FREQ : « descending frequency count » ; MAXDEC= : décimales du rapport affiché, sans effet sur l'OUT=) ; https://documentation.sas.com/doc/en/pgmsascdc/9.4_3.5/proc/p077f1i147m5k1n11qixyg0q9m9r.htm — FREQ Statement (« the procedure assumes that each observation represents n observations » : N et la variance pondérés, divisor Σw−1) ; https://documentation.sas.com/doc/en/pgmsascdc/9.4_3.5/proc/n1niocuk07q2wnn16mz96fboupgc.htm — ID Statement (« Includes additional variables in the output data set ») ; https://documentation.sas.com/doc/en/pgmsascdc/9.4_3.5/proc/p04vbvpcjg2vrjn1v8wyf0daypfi.htm — OUTPUT Statement (AUTONAME : « the combination of the analysis variable name and the statistic-keyword ») ; ordre des variables de l'OUT= (arbitrage J01-P2 rév. 3, décisions 5d0a9ac1 et c96c6088) BY → CLASS → _TYPE_ → _FREQ_ → ID → statistiques : https://support.sas.com/resources/papers/proceedings/proceedings/sugi31/043-31.pdf — SUGI 31, Coders' Corner, paper 043-31 (« the variables are arranged in the output dataset with the BY variables listed first, the CLASS variables, the _TYPE_, _FREQ_, and _STAT_, any ID variables, and finally the output statistics ») ; CLASS avant _TYPE_/_FREQ_ : https://documentation.sas.com/doc/en/pgmsascdc/9.4_3.5/proc/p1qko51z4vnlhan11xvjg4e5f20f.htm — Base SAS 9.4 Procedures Guide, Seventh Edition, MEANS Procedure, Example 10 « Computing Output Statistics with Missing Class Variable Values » (proc means data=cake chartype nway noprint; class flavor /order=freq ascending; class layers /missing; var TasteScore; output out=cakestat max=HighScore;) : le PROC PRINT publié de CAKESTAT (images/means_ex10.png) affiche les colonnes « Obs Flavor Layers _TYPE_ _FREQ_ HighScore », soit CLASS → _TYPE_ → _FREQ_ → statistiques, conforme à base/means-class-output (CLASS en tête)

issue: roadmap-avancee J01-P3 — PROC MEANS OUT= : position des variables ID. Ordre établi (arbitrage J01-P2 rév. 3, SUGI 31 paper 043-31 + doc SAS 9.4 MEANS Example 10) : BY → CLASS → _TYPE_ → _FREQ_ → ID → statistiques ; attendu [group, _TYPE_, _FREQ_, price, value_MEAN, value_STD], sasrs produit [group, price, _TYPE_, _FREQ_, …] (ID avant _TYPE_/_FREQ_)
